verdict.comment: Speedy TWILIGHT FUN is open to further improvement in retained headgear and gets the vote ahead of Fidelius.

comments.almatystar: In good form on AW this year; Goodwood win last term suggests he'll take well to Epsom
comments.elbufalo: Has failed to build on February win and faces a stiffer assignment back on turf
comments.existent: In a consistent vein of form but brings a portion of frustration (no win since 2022)
comments.faustus: Likely to handle Epsom, having won at Brighton in 2023; could go well
comments.fidelius: Made all in AW event on seasonal debut; has a consistent turf record; likely player
comments.jumbeau: Only 1-15 in handicaps but a 2022 novice win at Brighton suggests Epsom will suit
comments.michaelasboy: Has a better strike-rate on AW than on grass; three years since sole turf win
comments.onenightstand: Ran well in the 2023 Dash; had an excuse in this race last year; on an attractive mark
comments.spartanarrow: Didn't live up to expectations last time but has possibilities if taking well to headgear
comments.thecoffeepod: Both wins at York; never dangerous in last year's 3yo Dash in sole Epsom run
comments.twilightfun: Record of 3-5 (on AW) since wearing headgear; has won on turf; warrants respect

races.raceComment: fidelius is marginally preferred with a score of 56.7%, holding clear edges in more proven at trip and stronger recent form and more progressive over jumbeau. Won 2 of last 6 starts. Strong pace likely with multiple front-runners. verdict.comment: The one with least to prove is PURE SURF, who has her limitations but has posted two good efforts under Pippa Brown this month.

comments.crackingdestiny: Regressive 12yo who is having a disappointing campaign; needs to turn a corner
comments.dutycalls: Runs this track well but has been out of form this season and is best on soft ground
comments.friaryrock: Out of form when last seen last spring but resumes on workable mark; market may guide
comments.instinctdainay: Only minor promise in three novice/maiden hurdles; now chasing on handicap debut
comments.lowmileage: 0-16 over fences; went close two starts ago but didn't fire at Hexham last month
comments.puresurf: Held on well for small-field win at Newcastle this month and ran well in defeat soon after
comments.thejadfactor: Won in January but two very poor runs have followed; has a lot to prove all of a sudden
comments.toombridge: Has posted a couple of fairly good efforts this year but latest run was a backward step
comments.topofthecotswolds: Patently not the force of old but positives can be drawn from his latest run; new headgear

races.raceComment: puresurf is marginally preferred with a score of 61.4%. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter. Key attributes include optimal distance, though inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: Having bumped into a progressive rival when runner-up at Southwell last month, JEZ BOMB can go one better. Highland Olly is feared.

comments.coolree: Below best this year but he's below his last winning mark and is not written off
comments.highlandolly: Stayed on for second over 7f at Redcar recently and 1m is well worth a go; respected
comments.jezbomb: 4 wins in the second half of last year; returned to form when second at Southwell latest
comments.makalu: Three wins on turf last May-July and back on the scoresheet on AW last month; solid claims
comments.mountking: Ran well over C&D last May and now 10lb lower but disappointing more often than not since
comments.powerofzeus: No revival since joining this yard; a major turnaround is required in first-time headgear
comments.straya: 0-14 but has dropped down the weights and might not be far away now back down in trip
comments.tempertrap: Last five wins have come on soft or heavy ground and he has a poor reappearance record
comments.wildeanddandy: Two AW wins towards the end of last year but below par on AW the last twice

races.raceComment: jezbomb is marginally preferred with a score of 55.5%, holding clear edges in stronger recent form over tempertrap. Won 2 of last 6 starts. Going is a significant concern - yet to win on Good To Firm ground from 10 attempts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter. Key attributes include optimal distance and improving, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: This can go to EMERALD ARMY (nap), who was progressive over 7f last autumn and goes back up in trip after his recent 6f win here.

comments.captainvallo: Good second over 6f here recently; a contender if seeing out this longer trip
comments.dandylichious: Just one win from his 23 starts but fair second last time and each-way claims once more
comments.desertdream: May have needed reappearance run but needs to be an entirely different proposition today
comments.dumfries: Encouraging signs last autumn but he's now back to having something to prove
comments.emeraldarmy: Won in a big field here on his reappearance and could take modest 3lb raise in his stride
comments.falconnine: 19-race maiden who comes with risk attached but he might not be far away if breaking okay
comments.heroism: His mark continues to fall but he's dropped down the weights for good reason
comments.juryman: Very well handicapped on 2023 form but unable to get competitive last year
comments.kalganov: He's tumbled down the weights but has struggled in the last 12 months
comments.lumenbourg: Disappointing last month but won in February and could bounce back with a bold bid
comments.oddsockshavana: Went close on AW recently; it remains to be seen if he's still fully effective on turf
comments.ribbleradiant: 0-9 since debut win in June 2023 but good second on recent reappearance at Catterick
comments.withoutdelay: Three wins last year and reappeared with an encouraging fifth; could have a part to play

races.raceComment: captainvallo is marginally preferred with a score of 51.6%, holding clear edges in superior course form and more reliable profile over withoutdelay. Won 1 of last 6 starts, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: A very open race. BLACK HAWK EAGLE was a dual winner last season and, bar one blip, this campaign has been going okay.

comments.blackhawkeagle: C&D winner on a useful mark and it was a good handicap he ran in last time at Taunton
comments.clearance: A Newton Abbot specialist who was tailed off at Taunton after a lengthy break
comments.cornishstorm: Maiden winner who returns to an easier track after finishing third at Exeter
comments.gobletoffire: Good effort in a higher grade last time; fair shout provided he doesn't need the run
comments.magicseven: 4lb above last winning mark so needs to return from a break in top order
comments.moveitlikeminnie: Chequered record over fences continues last time but generally reliable over hurdles
comments.plantaroma: Mostly consistent but remains a maiden and only three ran when second at Ludlow
comments.prolificprofile: Three wins earlier this season and better again in defeat last time at Kempton
comments.tapley: Defied a higher mark earlier this season and he's been highly tried the last twice
comments.virtualhug: Long time since he won over hurdles; has been running just okay on the Flat
comments.zhangfei: This looks tougher after 5lb rise and record after a break isn't overly encouraging

races.raceComment: gobletoffire is marginally preferred with a score of 54.0%, holding clear edges in more progressive and more reliable profile over blackhawkeagle. Won 3 of last 6 starts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter. Excellent course form of 8/22 at hereford. Key attributes include improving.

verdict.comment: Race To Base could be hard to beat but CAPTAIN HUGO is bred to have a future and his yard's bumper horses have been going well.

comments.bourdingpass: Two forms of headgear fitted from the outset and yard is 0-12 in bumpers recent seasons
comments.captainhugo: Half-brother to 2m4f/2m7f hurdle winner Thecornerhouse; dam 2m4f/3m hurdle winner
comments.emeraldtime: Raced freely and didn't quite get home at Catterick, though was beaten under 8l
comments.joshcentral: Will need more than at Newton Abbot last time and he's bred to stay much further
comments.ledocteur: Dam French 2m-2m3f hurdle/chase winner, half-sister to smart jumper Chaninbar
comments.missbarfad: Dam a winning pointer and related to three successful jumpers; stable wins bumpers
comments.nopanic: Flat-bred 5yo; tongue tied for debut; stable has occasional success in bumpers
comments.ourbobbydazzler: Played his part in a contested lead before dropping away at Warwick a month ago
comments.paydirt: Newcomer from a yard that's 0-14 in these races the last five seasons
comments.racetobase: Has the best form and the benefit of course experience, so clear claims

races.raceComment: racetobase is marginally preferred with a score of 24.5%, holding clear edges in more proven at trip and better suited by conditions and superior course form and more progressive over joshcentral. Going is a significant concern - yet to win on Good ground from 3 attempts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter. Excellent course form of 1/3 at hereford. Key attributes include improving, though returning from absence and step up in class and inconsistent profile need consideration.
